entries.justification: Route /hardware, theme light, rule color-contrast. Phase 217 (FIX-01) drained this entry's `--qs-node-safe`+white vendor-risk badges (the zero-design-input `-foreground` swap, REQUIREMENTS.md FIX-01) from this baseline: count dropped 21 -> 5 in this regeneration (217-04, CI run 36634705275). Axe truncates its `samples` array to 3 representative nodes regardless of count, so not all 5 remaining nodes are individually itemized here. The 3 sampled remaining nodes are: two `role="note"` advisory banners using Tailwind default `text-yellow-700 dark:text-yellow-300` on a `bg-yellow-500/10` panel (repeated per advisory card), and a `label-eyebrow` span with a hardcoded inline `style="color: rgb(76, 164, 164)"` literal -- none match FIX-01's named `-foreground` swaps, FIX-02/FIX-03's `text-black` badge sites, or FIX-04's five named design-call tokens. These 3 are attributed to FIX-05 (Phase 218)'s general zero-below-AA verification bucket. The remaining 2 unsampled nodes are unknown -- needs triage in Phase 218 to confirm whether they repeat the same yellow-advisory/eyebrow classes or are a distinct site.
